definitions.explanation: The act of cleaning one's teeth with a toothbrush.
The paste or gel used when brushing teeth.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth) + ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧ (to polish/brush)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {歯磨|はみが}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to brush one's teeth)
- ⟦{歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}→歯磨き粉：04983_hamigakiko⟧ (toothpaste - more specific than {歯磨|はみが}き alone)
- ⟦{歯|は}ブラシ→歯ブラシ：04509_haburashi⟧ (toothbrush)

DUAL MEANING: {歯磨|はみが}き can mean both the action of brushing teeth and toothpaste itself, though ⟦{歯磨|はみが}き{粉|こ}→歯磨き粉：04983_hamigakiko⟧ is more explicitly 'toothpaste.'

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{歯|は}→歯：00778_ha⟧ (tooth)
- ⟦{歯医者|はいしゃ}→歯医者：01696_haisha⟧ (dentist)
- ⟦{虫歯|むしば}→虫歯：00299_mushiba⟧ (cavity, tooth decay)
